transcript: Off a frontage road in Round Rock, in a building that took phone orders, sits Horizon. Half is running. The rest comes winter or early next year. The operator's own guide says access is limited to internal users. The Q table under it is finished, priced by the node hour. West of there, the private campus at Abilene has an estimated 50,000 accelerators in one building. Nobody outside publishes that. Somebody spent three years porting code for a door that says no. What makes it public was never its size. The city measured the water and put it on a page. The only machine in Texas you can check is the small one.
